state: Production and tests frozen after focused GREEN and lint. Independent review and catalogue rerun requested. No commit, compiler, build or provider API call by this agent.
problem: The selected native Quality source text was admitted and inserted into the AnA stream, but neither gateway request supplied the existing final-dispatch checkpoint. A later access, current-fact, snapshot or disposition change could therefore leave stale native context in a provider request.
repair: Existing retained-source-context owner exports a native-only dispatch guard that privately copies authenticated organization/user/program scalars, exact IDs of originally supplied native contexts, and stable full/text digests, representation identity and supplied text facts.

Every invocation rereads those same IDs through the canonical current native reader and compares the exact supplied identity set. Missing/superseded/changed sources and failed/denied rereads refuse; empty native rereads cannot succeed.

The existing stream captures the guard once beside initial context and passes that same callback to both initial and follow-up gateway requests. The existing gateway owns terminal SOURCE_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE classification and SDK/capacity/credential checkpoints.
Retained-only and zero-native selections return no callback and perform no new reread. SDK implementation, model qualification, cancellation, API mounts and stores are unchanged.
